name: Fleet workers on a remote host
status_reason: Stub-ssh suites pass (host, host-setup, spawn-host, sync, land-remote, remote-worker). One live run on the VPS 2026-10-13: setup, spawn, worker commit+push and 4 reports worked; spawn hung after the banner and land was not exercised live.
description: fleet spawn --host runs a worker on a server over ssh. The Mac roster stays authoritative: the worker writes reports to a server outbox, fleet sync/watch pulls them, land refuses diffs outside claims. host-setup makes a bare repo and separate fleet clone.
purpose: Run fleet lanes on a server (own CPU, optionally its own Claude account) without giving the server any key into the Mac: all connections go Mac to server.

sources.claim: _spawn_remote: preflight, base push, remote worktree, kit ship and launch; cleans up on failure
_fleet_pane_state reports alive, dead or unreachable; an ssh failure is never dead
remote_land fetches the worker branch and refuses any diff outside the row's claims
host-setup creates ~/git/<name>.git and ~/fleet-repos/<name>, never touching existing server checkouts
fleet_project_name names the project after the main checkout, also from a linked worktree

unknowns: spawn --host did not exit after the banner in the first live run (killed by a 240s timeout); cause not traced
land for a host row has only run against stub ssh
Claude's Bash sandbox fails on the VPS (bwrap loopback RTM_NEWADDR), so workers there run commands unsandboxed
